conviction_note: MULTI has been a fixed-ratio merger target since 7 Sep (0.9725 Rejlers B per share, both EGMs approved 19 Oct). It trades at about 0.6% to Rejlers-implied value, and Rejlers reports its own Q3 at the same 08:30 on 3 Nov, so the window measures the combined group's reaction to two reports plus SEK/NOK, not Multiconsult alone. The only directional evidence is a partly priced Sweco/AFRY read-through and an easy year-ago base against an unsourced bar, so p_up is 52 on an abs_move of 4.0 (below the 7% 'new numbers' base because the peg roughly halves this print's weight, raised from 3.5 for thin turnover and three same-morning reports). The findings sum (+0.4) and the scaled number (+0.16) agree in sign; both are near zero on purpose.

findings.finding: MULTI is priced off Rejlers B, not off its own print: a fixed 0.9725 Rejlers B per share with both EGMs approved, trading about 0.6% from Rejlers-implied value on 2 Nov, and Rejlers publishes its Q3 at the same 08:30 on 3 Nov. The window's move is the combined group's reaction to both reports (Multiconsult about 54% of it) plus SEK/NOK.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print under the merger. Since 8 Sep MULTI's median absolute daily move is 0.96% (sd 1.8%) against Rejlers B at 0.89% (sd 1.6%) on Yahoo bars. Rejlers' own report-day median absolute move over 11 prints is 2.26%; MULTI's is 2.64%
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced by construction and carries no sign. It is filed because it decides the scale: a hunter sizing MULTI as a standalone Norwegian consultancy would over-weight Multiconsult's own numbers by about 2x and miss that Rejlers' report hits the same window. If the market had ignored the peg, the spread to Rejlers-implied value would be wide, and it is about 0.6% (MULTI 139.2 NOK vs 0.9725 x 151.8 SEK x 0.9487 NOK/SEK = 140.05 on 2 Nov Yahoo quotes).
findings.independence: Rejlers Q3 date 2026-11-03 08:30 from the MFN calendar (https://mfn.se/all/a/rejlers). The Nasdaq Nordic feed shows no Rejlers Q3 release yet (https://api.news.eu.nasdaq.com/news/query.action?type=json&freeText=Rejlers&globalGroup=exchangeNotice&globalName=NordicAllMarkets&limit=40)

findings.finding: Peer read-through is positive: Sweco reported its 'strongest third quarter results to date' on 29 Oct, with Norway among the main EBITA contributors and the improvement 'mainly driven by a strong billing ratio and higher average fees'. AFRY's Q3 (22 Oct) described an improved utilization rate. Billing ratio is exactly Multiconsult's weak line (70.1% in Q3 2025, down 1.1pp).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Multiconsult fell 4.4% on Q3 2025 ('competitive market', billing ratio down) and 11.3% on Q2 2025, so its billing-ratio misses have been punished. This read-through has no prior instance
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Rejlers B rose from 138.0 (20 Oct) to 151.8 (2 Nov) across the AFRY and Sweco prints, and MULTI's 5-day run-up is +2.5%. Kept small because it is a proxy, it is transmitted at about 54% through the peg, and Norconsult's Q3 at 07:00 the same morning will update the Norwegian read before MULTI opens.
findings.independence: AFRY Q3 2026, improved utilization, 22 Oct (https://mb.cision.com/Main/15400/4413426/4331027.pdf, snippet_only, not opened)

findings.finding: The year-ago base is easy and the quarter is calendar-neutral: Q3 2025 EBITA adj was NOK 62.1m (5.2% margin) on a billing ratio of 70.1%; Q3 2026 has the same 66 weekdays; ViaNova (closed 3 Dec 2025) is now in the numbers; management guided 'further improvement through 2026'. Against that, the order backlog was down 14% y/y at end-Q2 (NOK 3,952m vs 4,575m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 prints: 2024 +0.8%, 2025 -4.4%. The last two prints (Q1 2026 +0.1%, Q2 2026 -2.8%) improved y/y and were not rewarded, so improvement gets sold or ignored here
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: a y/y improvement on a weak base is what the company guided to, so it sits inside the guide and goes toward 0. The bar is unsourced (no consensus found), which caps it. The weekday count and the ViaNova consolidation are arithmetic nobody needed to publish, but they are not hidden.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 release, 'measures we have initiated will contribute to further improvement through 2026' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680032), the same issuer, so not independent

findings.finding: Merger transaction and advisory costs will most likely sit in Q3 reported EBITA as a one-off; the merger plan quantifies only post-completion integration costs (about SEK 40m) and SEK 100-120m of annual cost synergies within three years.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this name; one-offs below adjusted EBITA have not driven its prints
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference: no document gives the Q3 amount. It is sized as a fraction of the same money as operating profit, because it will be adjusted out and has no path to the guide.

outside_window.finding: Competition clearances (Norwegian, Swedish and Polish authorities) and FDI screening, then completion and first Oslo trading day of Multiconsult Rejlers, guided 'late 2026/early 2027'; long stop 30 June 2027. A block or remedies would reprice the peg
Sotra Link appeal at Borgarting Court of Appeal over about NOK 84m of cancellation damages plus about NOK 31.4m of costs awarded to Multiconsult

baseline_tension: Little tension: the run-up is flat to mildly negative over 20d (-1.1%) and positive over 5d (+2.5%), there is no short anchor, and my slight positive lean agrees with the recent peer-driven drift and so is mostly priced.
language_note: nothing the English sources did not already carry: every Multiconsult and Rejlers release was dual-language, NewsWeb carried them in English, and the Norwegian press (e24, DN) had nothing on Q3. The one locally useful item was the Swedish-language MFN calendar listing Rejlers' Q3 for 2026-11-03 08:30, the fact that sets this name's scale
lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise; the offer is the finding': confirmed that the merger peg belongs at the head of the findings. Not applied as 'results are noise', because a share-for-share ratio passes the combined group's reaction through, unlike a cash bid
'Understatement is the systematic error' / 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 4.0 (thin turnover, three same-morning reports)
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the proxy rule: the Sweco/AFRY read-through cut from +0.4 to +0.3 and p_up from 53 to 52
